scripts.deploy: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy --project-name react-native-deploy --branch master
scripts.build:pages: vite build --outDir .pages-dist/deploy/dashboard --emptyOutDir && npm --prefix ../docs-site run build && rm -rf .pages-dist/deploy/docs && cp -R ../docs-site/.vitepress/dist .pages-dist/deploy/docs && printf "export { default } from '../worker/index.js';\n" > .pages-dist/_worker.js
